channel.title: The Hockey News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hockey News (thehockeynews.com)

item.title: NHL Trade Deadline 2026: The Five Biggest Losers
item.description: The NHL's 2025-26 trade deadline passed on Friday, and certain NHL teams missed key opportunities, squandering cap space and trade assets they could've used to improve. Which franchises fumbled badly at the deadline?

item.title: Did The Rangers Do Enough At The NHL Trade Deadline To Kick-Start Their Retool?
item.description: The New York Rangers are retooling, and at this year’s deadline, they owned the most sought-after player in Vincent Trocheck. They elected not to trade him, but will they come to regret that decision?

item.title: Top Five Stanley Cup Contenders Following The NHL Trade Deadline
item.description: Which teams surged after the NHL’s trade deadline on Friday? Here are our choices for the NHL’s top five Stanley Cup contenders after the deadline.

item.title: 'Best Player In The World': Tampa's Nikita Kucherov Dances On Maple Leafs For Sixth 100-Point Season
item.description: The Tampa Bay Lightning dismantled the Toronto Maple Leafs on ‘Hockey Night In Canada,’ with Nikita Kucherov stealing the show, inching closer to another Art Ross Trophy and improving his quest for the Hart Trophy in the process.

item.title: Make Or Break Time: The Oilers Upcoming Road Trip Will Show What This Team is Made Of
item.description: The back-to-back defending Western Conference champions are sitting in the Pacific Division’s third playoff spot, and with a road trip that includes Vegas, Colorado, and Dallas, the room for error is near zero with 19 games to go in the regular season.

item.title: Three PWHL Players Trade No. 24 For No. 23 On 23-Hour International Women's Day
item.description: International Women's Day lasts 23 hours for much of Canada and the United States due to the move to Daylight Savings Time on Sunday. The PWHL got creative as a result to increase support for getting more girls to play the sport.

item.title: Do The Oilers Or Any Pacific Division Team Deserve To Be In The Playoffs?
item.description: The NHL’s playoff format ensures three teams from each division make the post-season, but if the season ended today, no Pacific Division team would make the playoffs in the Eastern Conference.

item.title: A Unique Situation Allowed The Islanders To Convince Brayden Schenn To Waive His No-Trade Clause
item.description: A unique situation allowed New York Islanders coach Patrick Roy and GM Mathieu Darche to speak face-to-face with recently acquired Brayden Schenn to convince him to waive his no-trade clause and accept a deal.

item.title: Holy Mackinaw: The Best Calls Of Joe Bowen’s Maple Leafs Broadcasting Career
item.description: Joe Bowen has been the voice of the Toronto Maple Leafs for 44 years, delivering passion and demonstrating his love for his job in every call. The all-time great commentator will retire at the end of the season, and today we look back at some of his most iconic calls.

item.title: Four NHL Players Who Made Strong First Impressions With Their New Team
item.description: Most NHL players acquired at this season's trade deadline have played their first game with their new team. But which NHLers made their mark right out of the gate with their new teams?
